implementation_recommendation: HOLD; no MPC or successor selected for implementation
scope: Current-source inspection and reductions of already saved consumed TRAIN evidence only. This is a feasibility report, not a frozen execution protocol or candidate result.

champion.name: crossing_projection + collision-shield v1
champion.verification: Standalone restore.py verify validates bundle manifest/checksums without importing Agent or simulator. No restore/rebuild requested or executed.

official_contract.observation: act receives only normalized float32 grayscale array (4,84,84); reset clears episode state. Own causal observation/action/internal history may persist.
official_contract.action: finite [steer,gas,brake] in [-1,1] x [0,1] x [0,1]; positive steer is right
official_contract.runtime: Linux Docker, Python3.11, CPU, participant process1024MB; import/init10s, reset5s, act5s
official_contract.startup: Reset stack repeats one final warmup image four times; three decisions are needed for four distinct endpoints. Returned warmup image has settled zoom.
official_contract.timing_caveat: 0.08s is simulated hold, not an80ms wall deadline. frame_skip4 and max_steps2000 are published local defaults and frozen champion assumptions, not an independent server-worker audit. No public CPU-core quota was established.

direct: four normalized grayscale images including HUD
permitted_derived: visible obstacle components and uncertain tracks
internal timers based only on permitted inputs
observation_boundary.offline_label_rule: Privileged archived fields are evaluation targets and diagnostic strata only. They must not initialize an observer, form runtime eligibility gates, resolve direction online or supply future geometry/actions.

camera.type: hull-locked orthographic, no camera yaw/translation smoothing in current source
camera.caveat: Rasterization, two resizes and uint8 grayscale precede Agent input. Subpixel mass may contain information; these scales are neither measured decoder accuracy nor hard quantization-error bounds.

primary_champion_log_reduction.observations_saved: pre/post SHA256 only, not image arrays
primary_champion_log_reduction.action_support_limit: No simultaneous gas0/brake0 coast actions in this cohort; many distinct triples do not imply randomized joint excitation or support for every local pedal alternative.
primary_champion_log_reduction.validation: Episode-report, episode/raw/decision hashes verified; action equality, physical PRE/raw/POST joins and observation-hash continuity asserted. Runtime features aligned to PRE, not top-level POST trace fields.
primary_champion_log_reduction.quantiles: Absolute residuals, linear interpolation at(n-1)*q, pooled dependent decision rows; not independent trial counts or confidence intervals.

hud_vs_mean_current_previous_pre_speed.note: This target reflects champion two-frame averaging. No calibration parameters were fitted.

previous_shield_wheel_estimate_vs_curren.note: Compare previous POST internal estimate to current PRE NEGATED physical front-joint mean. Physical joint and action-positive estimate have opposite signs. Supports actuator tracking only, not vehicle yaw/XY prediction.

existing_unscaled_50_38_slope_all_availa.note: Includes directed-road pi ambiguity during reverse travel. A road-axis proxy is not a calibrated directed heading measurement.

state_metrics.runtime_yaw_estimate: No yaw estimate stored; new HUD/flow decoder cannot be tested from hashes.
state_metrics.proxy_definitions: With X=1.3608,Y=1.701: near phi=atan2((c50-c54)*Y/4,X), b=(c54-9*(c50-c54)/4-42)/X, lateral=-b*cos(phi); heading proxy=atan2((c38-c50)/X,12/Y). These static algebraic proxies use ahead rows, extrapolate at least5.29 world units to the car and confound road curvature. They are not optimized estimators or an impossibility result.

obstacle_metrics.limits: 4px association truncates errors; these are NOT unconditional detector accuracy or false-negative rates. Crop membership does not prove visibility. No interior matched reappearance gap was found, but edge/entire-run misses remain. Shield stores box counts, not box geometry/IDs in these logs. Zero actual collisions cannot validate collision recall.

primary_champion_log_reduction.future_label_limit: Overlapping observed trajectories with changing endogenous actions, not independent trials or arbitrary-action outcomes. No general saved position/heading predictions for these horizons; no new forward model was fitted or run.
primary_champion_log_reduction.sprint_reuse: All eight sprint72 champion arms are exact raw/state/action/hash repeats. Six first-divergence brake-only forks span four geometries; two seed15 layouts share the same early fork. No later matched-time state equality returns. Their later suffixes include different endogenous control, not the proposed common continuation or a joint grid.

other_saved_pixel_evidence.inspection: Metadata/header/hash only; no image decoding or estimator evaluation.
other_saved_pixel_evidence.limits: RLPD/Oracle consumed TRAIN, not champion data or fresh holdout. Includes repeated prefixes and preparation masks. Saved position/speed/heading/heading_error/center_error and executed-action headers offer a possible future observer-validation source after exact timing/history/provenance checks. Do not claim champion-distribution coverage.

compute_evidence.cohort: same eight frozen_shield episodes,2130 saved act_latency_ms samples
compute_evidence.boundary: MeasuredAgent.act plus conversion/validation and in-act probes. Excludes env.step, subsequent observer logging and process setup; not pure production Agent timing or official-host benchmark.

exact_package_synthetic_smoke.note: Historical package receipt only, not a new benchmark or representative intervention test.

compute_evidence.existing_projection: 34 steering rows,4 holds,constant speed; adaptive substeps q=max(8,ceil(.3804811453*v)) per hold. Atv60 q23; validv<80 givesq<=31. These are model sampling substeps, NOT physics ticks.
compute_evidence.cost_limits: Three uncertainty scenarios triple element-work. Horizon increases Python loop iterations; collision/road tests and feature extraction add work. Source has no hard box-count cap. Counts do not constitute a new predictor benchmark.
compute_evidence.allowance_status: Engineering estimate only on comparable hardware for small batched arithmetic/geometry. Derived conservatively from~45ms historical wrapper maximum and up to2.5x loop/3.31x element-work additions. Not a measured latency, hard bound or p99 forecast; new visual flow/model complexity may invalidate it.
compute_evidence.target_status: Prospective design target, not an official limit or passed gate. Complete-path latency and maximum must be measured if separately authorized.

forward_model_assessment.feasible_hypothesis: Low-dimensional body/road-relative state with speed, velocity-direction uncertainty, heading/road shape, yaw tendency, actuator/gas memory and uncertain obstacle geometry; action-conditioned turn-rate and longitudinal response, not an exact simulator clone.
forward_model_assessment.shield_cannot_supply_joint_model: Frozen projector has no gas/brake argument and constant speed. Same steering with different pedals gives identical projected paths.
forward_model_assessment.horizon: Start prospective validation at.08s and.32s. Consider.48 only after error/support pass. At speed60,.8s travels48 world units versus~37 raw forward view and~32-33 current far detection; beyond-view road/obstacles are unknown, not free space.
forward_model_assessment.uncertainty_illustration: Small-angle sensitivity only, NOT a new validated model: atv60, yaw-rate error.1rad/s contributes approximately.3072/.6912/1.92 lateral units at.32/.48/.8s; speed error2 contributes.64/.96/1.6 along units. Relative errors may partly cancel, but this must be tested rather than assumed.

historical_counterevidence.observation: Learned H5=.40s reward ordering74/91 informative pairs on12 anchors; four-way gate still failed. Not physical pose/collision accuracy or champion-local ranking.

Different12-anchor TRAIN cohort: H5 Q0 concordant68/93 versus H3 Q0 70/93 on identical H5 outcomes; both tied-best7/12, H5 regret worse. Longer planning is not automatically better. No TD-MPC2 execution/reopening follows.

shield_reuse.unchanged_assumptions: Candidate steer only first.08s, then CURRENT nominal steering for.24s; constant recent-max HUD speed; command-integrated wheel angle; no actual yaw/slip, gas/brake response or calibrated perception bound.
shield_reuse.fallback: Unknown, infeasible, launch-prefix or exhausted encounter budget returns nominal, not a proven safe emergency action.
shield_reuse.composition_blocker: No generic executed-action hook. Nominal commits brake_history before returning; shield then commits its own wheel/box estimates. Outer pedal changes stale nominal history; outer steering changes stale shield state. Repeated speculative act calls mutate state repeatedly.
shield_reuse.possible_reuse: Projection, footprint and veto ideas can be reused in a separate successor with honest one-query/selection/executed-action-commit semantics and new validation. Frozen champion/shield source remains untouched. Fallback on a changed trajectory is not restoration of the original baseline trajectory.

observed_distribution_counterexample.note: Unchanged v1 shield with changed nominal trajectory did not preserve prior outcomes. This is no universal mechanism claim.

architecture_comparison.inference: architecture-dependent; a reactive replacement could be cheap, a learned planner expensive
architecture_comparison.risk: largest distribution shift; no basis to proceed now

architecture_comparison.implementation: medium-high: state observer, coupled model, multi-hold optimization, constraints and terminal behavior

architecture_comparison.inference: small-state search may fit CPU budget, but more sequence candidates amplify model error
architecture_comparison.risk: optimizes model bias and unknown continuation; not recommended before ranking evidence

architecture_comparison.implementation: lowest conditional scope, but still requires a separate observer/model and honest action-commit adapter
architecture_comparison.data: local action-response and paired ranking evidence; current brake-only forks insufficient
architecture_comparison.inference: one perception/nominal query plus7-15 batched candidates, initially.32s
architecture_comparison.risk: history mismatch, subpixel-small benefits, fallback/terminal debt and selection bias remain

smallest_conditional_structure.candidates: Nominal plus clipped local steer/pedal variants, preferably3 steer x3 signed-pedal levels=at most9 unique candidates, including exact baseline. Signed pedal maps to mutually exclusive gas/brake for this proposed bank, not a claim that the official action box requires exclusivity.
smallest_conditional_structure.state: Causal runtime-only observer and actual issued history; no privileged initialization or future smoothing.
smallest_conditional_structure.prediction: First.08s candidate, declared common continuation to.32s, variable speed/turn response and uncertainty. Hold-current-nominal is only a testable tail hypothesis, not future champion foresight.
smallest_conditional_structure.selection: Baseline-relative terminal/trajectory cost includes obstacle risk, soft road support, speed, heading/reentry debt and control effort. Independent one-sided collision condition; gains cannot compensate a safety violation. No unobserved progress label at runtime.
smallest_conditional_structure.abstention: Unsupported perception/direction/contact regime, beyond-view footprint, continuation-sensitive ordering or gain below selection-aware pairwise uncertainty returns baseline proposal. Universal abstention is not a useful controller result.
smallest_conditional_structure.commit: Exactly one observation/nominal update and one real executed-action commit in isolated successor. Exact baseline parity while never intervening is a prerequisite. Frozen source/ZIP remains unchanged.

minimum_future_falsification.authorization: PROPOSAL_ONLY; no new estimator, predictor, fit, benchmark or branch execution performed or authorized by this report
minimum_future_falsification.stage0: Verify saved frames, causal histories, action timing and labels in existing TRAIN archive. Deduplicate prefixes/repeats and split whole road geometries including all layouts/windows together. KOI hashes cannot validate new image estimators; RLPD pixel archive offers a separate-domain possibility, not champion replacement evidence.
minimum_future_falsification.stage1: Freeze one small observer and fixed predictor; assess speed/actuator, then directed local heading and yaw/heading increment, lateral position, then variable-speed displacement and obstacle clearance. Use actual executed sequences as retrospective controls at.08/.32/.48/.8; report conditional-prediction status, complete/censored coverage, per-road tails and failure states. Compare with action-independent persistence; no future action may become deployment input.
minimum_future_falsification.stage2: Before any nine-way claim, use a genuinely matched saved state/action fork and matching declared continuation to test baseline versus one supported local alternative. Existing sprint forks only test brake response with endogenous suffixes. Absent compatible joint forks means ranking is not identifiable here; any collection requires separate authorization, not automatic rollout.
predeclare_before_test_outcomes: useful intervention coverage on each eligible geometry
CPU full-path p99/maximum and fallback budget
stop_conditions: required saved inputs or compatible action forks absent
initial-state or.32s prediction error exceeds candidate separation/clearance margins
action-conditioned forecasts add no held-geometry signal over persistence
gain is smaller than pairwise error or useful coverage collapses under abstention
declared continuation is not implementable or rankings reverse under credible tails
honest executed-action history cannot be maintained without violating the baseline isolation contract
minimum_future_falsification.interpretation: A failure postpones this joint-control direction; a narrow offline pass permits proposing another scoped feasibility gate, not controller implementation, champion replacement, lap-improvement claim or shield inheritance.

analysis_provenance.scratch_retention_note: Scratch files are host-local, not a published source snapshot. Durable primary logs/receipts and explicit reduction formulas above support this report; no claim that temporary analysis files were committed or transferred.
analysis_provenance.independent_conceptual_review: Confirmed observational/causal distinction, exact continuation and query/commit prerequisites, geometry grouping, useful abstention coverage and selection-aware uncertainty. No new source/model execution.
analysis_provenance.shared_document_boundary: Concurrent publication staged existing current-state/KOI analysis documents during this study. They were not edited here; this separate receipt and append-only talk closure preserve the feasibility finding without modifying another session's staged work. No model/decision status is promoted.
